name: Ten'ou Hajime
source:
The main protagonist who is the heir of one of Japan's most prestigious families. Because of his innate talent and endless efforts, Hajime secured a high status at a young age. His appearance gives off the image that he's very arrogant, something he doesn't bother hiding, especially because he sees himself as a king. He rather enjoys situations that don't go his way.

He is a truly perverted guy who prefers when his partners resist him and act reluctant. Not once in his life has he masturbated because he has never seen a reason for it.
